Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the point where the mother sees the cemetery, add a small detail about her reaction: “孟母皱着眉头，看着安静的墓地。”
2. After the mother decides to move, add her inner thought or quoted speech: “孟母心想：‘这里不适合孟子长大。’”
3. When describing the new place, add one concrete detail that shows why it is nearer to the city: “新家附近有很多商店，街上很热闹。”

ideas.reason: This gives a fitting concrete reaction to the cemetery and uses simple, correct Chinese.
This adds a natural thought that explains why Meng Mu decides to move.
This concretely describes the busier area they move to and fits the next part of the tale.
